label: <DEL> step of long (L=9, some L=8) sequences
explanation: Fires almost only on the delimiter step (100% of activation mass at phase 1, i.e. when the model is about to emit original token 0), and only for long sequences: about 60% of L=9 delimiters are active (85% of mass) and about 18% of L=8 delimiters (15% of mass). It never fires for L<=7 or anywhere in the copy phase, and fires on original-phase steps only a handful of times (16 of 12948). (phase==1)&(L>=8) covers 99.95% of mass but has precision 0.39. Which L=9 delimiters fire depends weakly and diffusely on content: higher rate when there are more digits in the sequence (rate per step goes from 0.7x with 0 digits to 2x with 4 or more) and for some first tokens (z, 3, 2, w, p, k, r). No compact token rule separates active from inactive delimiters, and token-set refinements made F1 worse.
